title: 第13章 未婚妻你另一个未婚夫来了第14章 真假未婚夫之战
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
说罢，百里魇一挥手，冒着热气和香味的各色佳肴，直接摆满了桌。
“问天宗的灵膳，最多采用灵草灵药。”百里魇嫌弃的话音说着：“本尊拿出的这些灵膳，可是用了仙药仙植，比之问天宗的珍贵得多。”
“随意吃。”百里魇抬手一挥，大方开口：“只要你安心为我魔族办事，好处本尊自然不会少了你。”
“还是你有良心。”昭杺柠对他竖了个大拇指，也不客气，最先扯了个烧鸡鸡腿。
一口下去，烧鸡鸡腿油香多汁，还带着一股沁人心脾的果香，昭杺柠直接被香迷糊了。
饿了一下午，可算吃到东西，昭杺柠雨露均沾，每一样菜都尝了一筷子。
吃饱喝足以后，昭杺柠发现自己穿越这个游戏修仙世界，唯一的好处就是，这个世界的灵膳是真的十分之美味。
至少制作灵膳的食材，都是带有灵气，可以蕴养身体的。
吃饱以后，昭杺柠看着剩下的灵膳，开始纠结了。
毕竟钟离珟那狗东西明显怀疑她，今晚不给她饭吃，搞不好以后也没吃的。
有着长远打算的昭杺柠，开始琢磨剩下的这些灵膳，自己放在哪里既不会被钟离珟发现，也能将食物保存完好。
“拿着。”一旁的百里魇，突然往她怀里抛来一个东西。
昭杺柠连忙伸手接住，发现是一枚暗红色花纹诡异的戒指。
“这是干嘛？”百里魇突然给她一枚戒指做什么。
“这是空间戒。”百里魇怀疑的话音问来：“既不认识空间戒，也不知道天道姻缘，你到底是不是星灵大陆的人？”
“你猜。”昭杺柠呲牙一笑，直接回敬百里魇前不久不告诉她天道姻缘同生共死的仇。
“我猜你不是。”百里魇轻笑着，话音却是笃定。
毕竟刚刚昭杺柠用膳时，他一直在旁观察。
结果就是，昭杺柠怎么看都不像是星灵大陆的人。
她的表现给旁人的感觉，就是对星灵大陆太过陌生了。

但这些，对于百里魇来说都不是问题。
他不管昭杺柠来自哪里，只要昭杺柠是人类就好。
是人类，就可以替他好好潜伏在问天宗。
如果昭杺柠不是星灵大陆的人，百里魇倒是更放心昭杺柠往后归顺魔族。
“本尊说过，只要好好替我魔族办事，好处自然不会少你的。”
看着昭杺柠正在研究戒指，百里魇解释：“这枚戒指中有食物，也有星石，算是你成功潜入问天宗本尊对你的奖励。”
说完以后，百里魇专门停顿片刻，摇着扇子等待昭杺柠应带有喜悦对自己的感激之情。
可是他等了半天，昭杺柠除了盯着那枚戒指翻来覆去的看，一点对他奖励的感谢反应都没。
“昭杺柠，你到底有没有听本尊说的话？”百里魇忍不住了。
这一刻，昭杺柠才放下研究戒指的手，一脸深沉点头：“魔尊啊，道理我都懂，但是这空间戒到底怎么用？”
“我看半天了，你不配个说明书还不帮忙讲解一下吗？”
“不是我说啊，你这样当领导者，说话含含糊糊的，会让手底下的人很难帮你办事的，我觉得你这魔尊有点当不太明白。”
如果这魔尊，换她来当就好了。
content_en:
After saying that, Baili Xiang waved his hand, and the table was filled with all kinds of steaming and fragrant delicacies.
"The Wentian Sect's spiritual meals mostly use spiritual herbs and elixirs." Baili Xiang said in a disgusted voice: "The spiritual meals I took out are made of elixirs and immortal plants, which are much more precious than those of the Wentian Sect."
"Eat as you like." Baili Xiang raised his hand and said generously: "As long as you work for my demon clan with peace of mind, I will naturally not miss you."
"You still have a conscience." Zhao Hao Ning gave him a thumbs up and was not polite. He took the roasted chicken drumstick first.
After one bite, the roasted chicken drumstick was oily and juicy, with a refreshing fruity aroma. Zhao Hao Ning was directly confused by the aroma.
After being hungry all afternoon, I finally got something to eat. I was dipped in Zhaohao lemon rain and dew, and I tasted one chopstick of each dish.
After eating and drinking enough, Zhao Hao Ning found that he traveled through the world of cultivating immortals in this game. The only good thing is that the spiritual food in this world is really delicious.
At least the ingredients used to make spiritual meals contain spiritual energy and can nourish the body.
After eating, Zhao Huning looked at the remaining spiritual meal and began to be confused.
After all, that bitch Zhong Lizui obviously doubted her. If he didn't give her food tonight, he might not have anything to eat in the future.
Zhao Huning, who had long-term plans, began to think about where to put the remaining spiritual meals without being discovered by Zhong Lizui, and where he could keep the food intact.
"Take it." Baili Xiang on the side suddenly threw something into her arms.
Zhao Haining quickly reached out to catch it and found it was a dark red ring with strange patterns.
"What's this for?" Baili Xiang suddenly gave her a ring.
"This is the space ring." Baili Xiang asked in a doubtful voice: "I don't know the space ring, nor do I know about the marriage between heaven and earth. Are you from the Star Spirit Continent?"
"Guess." Zhao Hao Ning grinned and directly responded to Baili Xiang's hatred for not telling her that they were destined to live and die together.
"I guess you're not." Baili Xiang chuckled, but his voice was firm.
After all, he had been observing from the sidelines while Zhao Haining was eating.
The result was that Zhao Hao Ning did not look like a person from the Star Spirit Continent.
Her performance gave others the impression that she was too unfamiliar with the Protoss Continent.
But these are not problems for Baili Xiang.
He doesn't care where Zhao Hao Ning comes from, as long as Zhao Hao Ning is human.
If he is a human being, he can lurk in Wentian Sect for him.
If Zhao Hao Ning was not from the Star Spirit Continent, Baili Xiang would be more confident that Zhao Hao Ning would submit to the demon clan in the future.
"I said that as long as you do things for my demon clan properly, the benefits will naturally come to you."
Seeing Zhao Hao Ning studying the ring, Baili Xiang explained: "This ring contains food and star stones. It can be regarded as your reward for successfully sneaking into Wentian Sect."
After finishing speaking, Baili Xiang paused for a moment, waving his fan and waiting for Zhao Hao Ning to express his gratitude to him with joy.
But after he waited for a long time, Zhao Hao Ning didn't even respond to his gratitude for the reward except staring at the ring and turning it over and over.
"Zhao Hao Ning, did you listen to what I said?" Baili Xiang couldn't help it.
At this moment, Zhao Haining put down the hand that was studying the ring and nodded with a deep expression: "Demon Lord, I understand the truth, but how do you use this space ring?"
"I've been reading it for a long time. If you don't have a manual, why don't you help explain it?"
"I'm not telling you that. If you are a leader like this and speak vaguely, it will make it difficult for the people under you to help you. I think you, the Demon Lord, are a little too understanding."
It would be nice if she could be the Demon Lord.
